body.heading: Set up the bakery
paragraphs: Roll your dough into cakes, buns, and one very wobbly jelly. Line them up on the tray.
Make a sign for your bakery and decide what today's special is.

body.heading: Serve the customers
paragraphs: Take orders from your toys and family: One rainbow cake, please. Count the cakes as you serve them.
Bakers use patterns: every cake gets three berries, every bun gets a swirl.

takeaway: A good baker makes the same cake the same way, every single time.
safetyNotes: Playdough is for playing, never for eating; wash hands before and after.
